selection_basis: For each held-out origin, choose the WAPE-minimizing weight on all other origins; production weight is the mean of those out-of-origin selected weights.
replacement_transfer_assumption: For a launched replacement SKU with no own demand history, transfer the replaced SKU-region seasonal forecast at a 1.0 ratio until the successor has its own history.
price_revenue_assumption: Revenue estimates use the latest positive observed SKU price through Oct 2026 and apply explicitly listed future global price-change events; no demand elasticity is assumed.
